$comment: Authenticated perf budgets (server response time, observed TTFB + first byte over local HTTPS). Journeys: member-rsvp (GET /e/:key with a member session cookie: the personalized detail read with attendees/RSVP/waitlist) and moderator-admin (GET /admin/events with a moderator session cookie: the bounded list read behind adminGuard). samples is at least five per journey for calibration. Ceilings were calibrated from two independent pinned ubuntu-24.04 browser-smoke runs (ten samples per journey; slowest member-rsvp sample 100 ms, slowest moderator-admin sample 28 ms), keeping the 500 ms median ceiling over 11x the highest measured run median (44 ms member-rsvp, 23 ms moderator-admin) and the 1000 ms single-sample ceiling at least 10x the slowest sample to absorb runner variance while still catching sustained median regressions above 500 ms (unindexed scans, N+1 reads, upstream-coupled refresh). See docs/performance-budgets.md. Never relax a ceiling to make CI green. member-rsvp path names the browser-smoke seeded published event from e2e/seed.mjs; AUTH_PERF_EVENT_KEY overrides it when the seed changes.
